title.zh-CN: 前端接住 LLM 的流式输出
title.en-US: Receiving LLM Streams on the Frontend

summary.zh-CN: 从传输(SSE 还是 fetch 手撕流)、增量渲染与合帧、滚动锚定、可中断,到「流到一半的 Markdown」——把逐 token 输出稳稳接进界面的真实工程细节。
summary.en-US: From transport (SSE vs hand-rolled fetch streaming) to incremental render, frame coalescing, scroll anchoring, abort, and the half-written-Markdown problem — the real engineering of receiving a token stream in the UI.
